LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic record search/select component for Screen Flows. Configure the object, search fields, display fields, an optional scoping filter, and the access level to query under.

property.name: label
property.label: Field Label
property.description: Label shown above the search input

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object to search, e.g. Venue__c

property.name: searchFields
property.label: Search Fields
property.description: Comma-separated API names of fields to search against, e.g. Name,Town__c

property.name: displayFields
property.label: Display Fields
property.description: Comma-separated API names of fields to show in each result. The first field is used as the title, e.g. Name,Address__Street__s,Town__c

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field (optional)
property.description: API name of a field to scope every search by, e.g. Organisation__c

property.name: filterValue
property.label: Filter Value (optional)
property.description: Value the Filter Field must equal - usually bound to a Flow variable, e.g. {!varBookingForm.Organisation__c}

property.name: accessLevel
property.label: Access Level
property.description: User Mode respects the running user's sharing and field-level access. System Mode bypasses both, e.g. for portal users who can't otherwise see the object - use only with a scoping Filter Field.

property.name: allowCreate
property.label: Allow Create New
property.description: When enabled, shows a 'Create new' option in the results so the user can indicate they want to create a record instead of picking an existing one. The component does not create the record itself - branch on Request New Record in the Flow and create it there. Leave off anywhere users shouldn't be able to add new records, e.g. some portal contexts.

property.name: createLabelPrefix
property.label: Create New Label Prefix
property.description: Text shown before the typed search term in the create-new option, e.g. 'Create new' produces Create new "Cape Town". Only used when Allow Create New is on.

property.name: selectedRecordId
property.label: Selected Record Id
property.description: Id of the record the user selected

property.name: selectedRecordLabel
property.label: Selected Record Label
property.description: Title text of the record the user selected

property.name: searchTerm
property.label: Raw Search Text
property.description: The text the user typed - useful for creating a new record when nothing matched

property.name: requestNewRecord
property.label: Request New Record
property.description: True when the user chose 'Create new' instead of selecting an existing record. Only ever true when Allow Create New is on.
